summary: Frontend-only validation of the discreet nav badge for Achats & Fournisseurs (module ACCOUNTING, sub-item acct_purchases). All 7 scenarios from the review request passed: badge presence, sub-item badge, acknowledgment on Aperçu open with localStorage persistence, reappearance after new AP invoice + visibilitychange revalidation, no audio/looping animation, company-scoped storage key, and badge content is a bare number (capped '9+').

minor.issue: Returns 405 Method Not Allowed for submitted invoices — no delete/void path available to clean up TEST invoices from within the app. Left a submitted TEST_ invoice in Meelora (sinv_38ed735dafb341a5b7bdbef84287d64f). Not related to badge feature.

detailed_results.TEST1_badge_present_module_ACCOUNTING: PASS — data-testid=nav-module-badge-ACCOUNTING renders with text '9+' after login + localStorage navbadge:* cleared.
detailed_results.TEST2_sub_item_badge: PASS — opening the ACCOUNTING flyout reveals data-testid=nav-item-badge-acct_purchases with text '9+'. Root badge stays visible in this build (not hidden) which is within the spec's tolerance ('peut être masqué' = optional).
detailed_results.TEST3_acknowledge_on_overview_open: PASS — clicking nav-acct_purchases opens the AP page (ap-overview-tab present), and after acknowledge both nav-module-badge-ACCOUNTING and nav-item-badge-acct_purchases are absent (null). localStorage key 'navbadge:acct_purchases:965f0770-8cf2-4199-a99f-819ff270436a' persists (~1115 chars of seen ids).
detailed_results.TEST3b_persistence_after_reload: PASS — after page.reload() the badges do NOT reappear (localStorage keeps them acknowledged).
detailed_results.TEST4_reappear_on_new_event: PASS — Created a new AP invoice (POST /ap/invoices, then /verify, then /submit; overview actionable_ids grew from 28 → 29). After dispatching visibilitychange hidden→visible, badge nav-module-badge-ACCOUNTING reappeared with text '9+' and sub-badge nav-item-badge-acct_purchases also '9+'.
detailed_results.TEST5_no_blinking_no_sound: PASS — 0 <audio> elements. Sub-badge has class 'ap-fade-in' with computed animation-name=apFadeIn and animation-iteration-count=1 (single fade-in, no looping/pulsing).
detailed_results.TEST6_company_scope: PASS (by storage key) — Persisted key is scoped by companyId: 'navbadge:acct_purchases:965f0770-8cf2-4199-a99f-819ff270436a'. Provider scopes fetch to active companyId per code review of NavBadgeContext.js.
detailed_results.TEST7_no_financial_data: PASS — Badge textContent is exactly '9+' (or a number). No amounts, currency, or details rendered inside the badge span.

critical_code_review_comments: NavBadgeContext.js correctly uses a single 30s polling + visibilitychange revalidation and a per-company localStorage key. Registry NAV_BADGE_SOURCES is extensible (no hardcoded AP-specific code in Layout.js — the NavCount component reads counts generically via useNavBadges()).

OverviewTab in PurchasesAP.js calls acknowledgeWith('acct_purchases', d.actionable_ids) on load — acknowledgment is idempotent and covers all currently-actionable ids, which correctly explains persistence across reloads.
Backend has no soft-delete/void endpoint for submitted AP invoices (DELETE → 405), which makes automated test cleanup awkward. Not in scope of this feature but worth tracking.
